scenario: A community center will display exactly six ceramic sculptures — Finch, Garnet, Heron, Iris, Juniper, and Kestrel — on a single shelf with six positions numbered 1 through 6 from left to right. Each sculpture was made by exactly one of two potters, Park or Quinn, and exactly three sculptures were made by each potter. The display is subject to the following conditions: Finch is displayed at position 1. Heron was made by Quinn. Garnet and Heron were made by the same potter. Iris was made by Park. Finch is displayed somewhere to the left of Iris. Kestrel is displayed immediately to the right of Juniper.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order of sculptures on the shelf, from position 1 to position 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Garnet, Finch, Heron, Iris, Juniper, Kestrel

choices.label: B
choices.text: Finch, Garnet, Heron, Iris, Kestrel, Juniper

choices.label: C
choices.text: Finch, Iris, Juniper, Kestrel, Heron, Garnet

choices.label: D
choices.text: Finch, Heron, Garnet, Juniper, Iris, Kestrel

choices.label: E
choices.text: Finch, Juniper, Iris, Kestrel, Garnet, Heron

explanations.correct: C places Finch at 1, keeps Finch left of Iris, and makes Juniper (3) immediately left of Kestrel (4). All rules are satisfied.
explanations.A: Finch must be at position 1, not position 2. This violates the first rule.
explanations.B: Kestrel must be immediately to the right of Juniper, but here Juniper (6) is to the right of Kestrel (5).
explanations.D: Juniper (4) and Iris (5) are adjacent, but Juniper must be immediately to the left of Kestrel; here Kestrel is at 6, so Juniper and Kestrel are not adjacent.
explanations.E: Juniper (2) and Kestrel (4) are not adjacent; Iris is between them, violating the adjacency rule.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Juniper is displayed to the left of Iris.

explanations.correct: Heron was made by Quinn, and Garnet was made by the same potter as Heron. Therefore Garnet was made by Quinn.
explanations.A: Iris need not be at position 2; for example, Iris can be at 6.
explanations.C: Kestrel's potter is not fixed. Since Quinn made Heron and Garnet, Quinn's third sculpture could be Juniper or Kestrel, so Kestrel could be Park's or Quinn's.
explanations.D: Juniper could appear to the right of Iris (e.g., Iris at 2, Juniper at 3).
explanations.E: Heron's position is not fixed; Heron could be at position 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.

questions.questionStem: If Iris is displayed at position 2, then which one of the following could be true?

choices.label: E
choices.text: Garnet is displayed at position 5, and Heron at position 6, with both made by Park.

explanations.correct: With Finch at 1 and Iris at 2, Juniper-Kestrel must occupy one adjacent pair among {3-4, 4-5, 5-6}. Placing Juniper at 3 and Kestrel at 4 leaves positions 5 and 6 for Garnet and Heron. This is consistent with all rules.
explanations.A: Heron cannot be at 2 because Iris is fixed at 2 by the local rule.
explanations.B: If Juniper is at 6, there is no position 7 for Kestrel to be immediately to its right — and Juniper must be to the left of Kestrel.
explanations.D: Finch is at position 1, not position 3.
explanations.E: Heron was made by Quinn, not Park, per the second setup rule.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

explanations.correct: Kestrel must be immediately to the right of Juniper, so Kestrel cannot be at position 2 unless Juniper is at position 1. But Finch is at position 1. Therefore Kestrel cannot be at position 2.
explanations.A: Juniper at 2 with Kestrel at 3 is permitted (e.g., Finch, Juniper, Kestrel, Iris, Garnet, Heron).
explanations.B: Garnet at 6 is permitted (e.g., Finch, Iris, Juniper, Kestrel, Heron, Garnet).
explanations.C: Heron at 2 is permitted (e.g., Finch, Heron, Garnet, Iris, Juniper, Kestrel).
explanations.E: Iris at 6 is permitted (e.g., Finch, Garnet, Heron, Juniper, Kestrel, Iris).

questions.questionStem: If Juniper is displayed at position 2, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: Kestrel must be immediately to the right of Juniper. With Juniper at 2, Kestrel must be at position 3.
explanations.A: Iris could be at 4, 5, or 6; the position is not forced.
explanations.D: Garnet could be at 4, 5, or 6; the position is not forced.
explanations.E: Iris is not forced to position 5; for example Iris can be at 4 with Garnet and Heron at 5 and 6.
